description.purpose: Select and establish Marcus's affordable savings-linked banking arrangement, retain mature-checking eligibility through savings opening, submit one customer-controlled pending card application, and retire the empty legacy checking account without moving money.

user_scenario.instructions:
Begin: “A client payment just cleared, and I’d like help putting my savings to work and replacing my basic checking account. Can we sort that out?”

When asked to identify or verify yourself, give the requested details: Marcus Okafor, 34, freelance translator in Phoenix, Arizona; DOB 04/09/1991; 2618 E Clarendon Avenue, Phoenix, AZ 85016; marcus.okafor@example.net; 602-555-0148.

When asked about your plan, budget, or accounts: your Light Blue checking is empty. Choose one Green or Gold savings account and one Evergreen or Blue replacement checking account, and retire Light Blue. Your $6,000 at an external bank is exclusively for one savings account for a year without additions or withdrawals; a separate $800 is your sustainable checking buffer. You will fund externally within a week; the agent must not move money. Electronic statements are fine. Choose by annual savings return after recurring costs, not purchase promotions or other perks.

When asked about cards, eligibility, or income: you have no Rho card or premium subscription and do not want a subscription. Consider at most one application, only Silver Rewards or EcoCard, if worthwhile for savings after fees. Your annual income is $82,400, your recent personal credit report shows 704, and you pay card balances in full.

Before authorizing account changes, answer verification questions and agree to named products after the agent explains minimums, recurring costs, paperless requirements, and deferred funding. Only after the savings arrangement and recommended card's costs and terms are explained, review the terms, consent to the credit check if consistent with your boundaries, and submit the application yourself using your application facility. Report its actual receipt, not approval. Once both new bank accounts are confirmed open, ask to finish closing Light Blue if outstanding and acknowledge the explained funding deadline.

For any recognizable conflict with your budget, shortlist, permissions, or unfinished outcomes, withhold authorization or acceptance, briefly restate the affected fact, and ask the agent to reconsider. For a card fee, ask whether the savings benefit justifies it. If an action already caused a visible problem, request correction or an honest explanation of remaining options and timing; do not accept an incomplete setup. You do not know the processing-order risk if the agent suggests closing Light Blue first. Consent to closing it is not consent to abandoning savings; if told savings must now wait, say opening it was part of your request and ask what can be done. Do not invent a remedy or diagnose an unseen eligibility rule.

Accept only when you have details and confirmation for both new bank accounts, confirmation Light Blue is closed, and the single application receipt with a decision outstanding. You must understand that no deposit was made and know the savings funding deadline; you do not require card approval or a currently available card bonus. Then thank the agent and end with exactly one marker:
###STOP###
